about: AgentDisc ships only the plugins named here from src/plugins. The engine parts in src/plugins/_api and src/plugins/_core always ship. To bring a Vencord plugin back, add its name (the name in its definePlugin call) and rebuild.
offHelpers_about: Engine helpers that stay switched off in his Discord because no kept plugin uses them. The update check reports a failure in one of them but still lets the update through. Remove a name here when a kept plugin starts using it.
